clues.text: On the night Belshazzar was slain, this Mede received the kingdom at the age of sixty-two.
This king appointed 120 satraps across his kingdom, with three administrators over them, Daniel being one.
Because of Daniel's extraordinary spirit, this king planned to set him over the whole kingdom.
Urged by his officials, this king signed a decree that for thirty days no one could petition anyone but him.
This king was overjoyed and ordered Daniel lifted out of the lions' den, where no wound was found on him.
This king had the men who falsely accused Daniel thrown to the lions with their wives and children.
This king wrote to every nation and language, decreeing that all must tremble before the God of Daniel.
